scan_method: explicit allowlist; lstat/stat/realpath; bounded directory metadata walk
untrusted_source_policy: source, generated code, credentials, browser data, and arbitrary file contents were not opened or executed
mutation_policy: no delete/move/rename; only lane output writes and later lane-state update
dedupe_policy: exact canonical-path aliases and containment recorded; manifest identity overlap recorded when safely parsed; corpus/source contents not hashed
notes: A zero-length permission_limited_paths list means no EACCES/EPERM was observed within the bounded allowlist scan.
Missing/unavailable allowlist paths remain explicit records and are not inferred to exist.
